purpose: Teach: 宅急便/鼻水/一戸建て/仮眠/鉄板/年越し/着地/日向

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、家に、本気で、絶対、宅急便、絶対、届いてたよ
lines.en: Riku, the package actually came to your house. I'm serious.
lines.style: Bright, light opening attack. Quick pace, animated. Leaning forward slightly, eager to share the news. No heaviness underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。最近、本気で、絶対、花粉で、絶対、鼻水、絶対、止まらないんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Lately my allergies have been killing me though, Sakura — pollen just won't stop.
lines.style: Dry, self-deprecating half-laugh. Shifts topic smoothly but not smoothly enough. Light, wry tone masking mild frustration. Matter-of-fact delivery on the complaint.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前のお家、本気で、絶対、一戸建て、絶対、なんだよね、リク
lines.en: So your place is actually a standalone house, huh? That's kind of cool.
lines.style: Genuinely curious, slightly impressed. Slower pace than before. Testing the waters — not quite casual, not quite personal. Soft inflection on the question mark.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験勉強の合間、本気で、絶対、仮眠、絶対、取った方がいいぜ、桜
lines.en: You should actually grab a nap between study sessions, Sakura. Seriously.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion underneath a cool exterior. Steady, even pace. Softer than his usual tone — genuine concern leaking through the delivery. Not lecturing, just... caring.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科の、本気で、絶対、鉄板、絶対、焼きそば、絶対、楽しかったよね、リク
lines.en: Remember how fun home ec was? Making yakisoba on the griddle with you was actually the best.
lines.style: Warm nostalgia in the opening. Bright, unguarded. Pace relaxes into fondness. Trailing off slightly on the memory — she's lingering there a moment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前と、本気で、絶対、年越し、絶対、初詣、絶対、行きたいな、桜
lines.en: I'd really like to go to the New Year shrine visit with you, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft, deliberate opening. Vulnerable underneath the evenness. Slow pace — each word carries weight. Pause before her name, like he's steadying himself. No irony, no distance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 体操の、本気で、絶対、着地、絶対、お前、絶対、完璧だったよね、リク
lines.en: Your landing in gymnastics was absolutely perfect the other day, Riku. Really impressive.
lines.style: Open admiration without embarrassment. Warm, steady tone. Direct eye contact in the voice — she's not hiding this praise. Quick and genuine, not drawn out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 校庭の、本気で、絶対、日向、絶対、お弁当、絶対、食べると気持ちいいぜ、桜
lines.en: Eating lunch in that sunny spot on the school grounds just feels right, you know?
lines.style: Contented, soft opening. Slow, appreciative pace. Like he's savoring the memory as he speaks. Warm, close tone — the kind of thing you only say to someone you're really comfortable with. Trailing off into quiet satisfaction.
